from fastapi import APIRouter, Path, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Optional
from datetime import datetime

router = APIRouter()

class ItemUpdate(BaseModel):
    name: Optional[str] = None
    description: Optional[str] = "Default description"
    price: Optional[float] = 0.0

class ItemResponse(BaseModel):
    id: int
    name: str
    description: str
    price: float
    updated_at: datetime

@router.put("/items/{item_id}", response_model=ItemResponse)
def update_item(
    item_id: int = Path(..., title="Item ID", description="The ID of the item to update"),
    item_update: ItemUpdate = Depends(),
):
    # Retrieve item data from database (mocked for this example)
    item_data = {"id": item_id, "name": "Item 1", "description": "This is a description", "price": 10.99}

    # Update item data with provided fields or fallback placeholder values
    updated_item_data = {
        "id": item_id,
        "name": item_update.name or f"Item {item_id}",
        "description": item_update.description or "Default description",
        "price": item_update.price or 0.0,
        "updated_at": datetime.utcnow(),
    }

    # Return updated item data
    return updated_item_data

# Export the router
__all__ = ["router"]
